documents.title: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulations.
Financial Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Radico Khaitan reported record financial performance for Q2 FY2027, driven by strong growth in its Prestige & Above portfolio and premiumization trends. Management upgraded the Prestige & Above volume growth guidance to 30 percent and reiterated the EBITDA margin guidance of around 20 percent for FY27. The company experienced higher working capital due to inventory buildup to mitigate grain price volatility, while net debt saw a reduction. Leadership changes were also announced to support the next phase of growth. Radico Khaitan reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, driven by its premiumization strategy, with the Prestige and Above (P&A) portfolio delivering robust volume growth.

guidance.claim: Management upgraded the Prestige & Above volume growth guidance to 30 percent for FY27.
guidance.quote: We upgrade our Prestige & Above volume growth guidance to 30% and reiterate EBITDA margin guidance of around 20% for FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects its Prestige and Above portfolio to deliver over 25% volume growth during FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we expect our P&A portfolio to deliver over 25% volume growth during FY27, supported by a robust innovation pipeline, expanding distribution and favorable industry trends.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining an EBITDA margin of around 20% for FY27.
guidance.quote: With premium brands accounting for an increasing share of our business, we remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margin of around 20% for FY27 while continuing to invest behind our brands and strengthen our long-term competitive position.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that premiumisation continues to define the Indian spirits industry, supported by rising aspirations, an evolving cocktail culture, and the expanding hospitality sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Premiumisation continues to define the Indian spirits industry. Rising aspirations, an evolving cocktail culture and the expanding hospitality sector are steadily drawing consumers towards brands built on quality, heritage and authenticity.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Karnataka's rationalised duty framework and Tamil Nadu's signals are supporting the long-term formalisation of the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: In Karnataka, the rationalised duty framework is showing early signs of a healthier, more premium-friendly market. Tamil Nadu, the country’s largest market, is also sending encouraging signals. Such progressive steps widen the opportunity for organised, branded players and support the long-term formalisation of the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that vodka is in the midst of a multi-year structural shift, with its share of the IMFL industry rising to 6.3 percent in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Vodka is in the midst of a multi-year structural shift, and its share of the IMFL industry has risen to 6.3% in Q2 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India's vodka category has grown at over 20 percent CAGR between FY22 and FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: India's vodka category has grown at over 20% CAGR between FY22 and FY26, significantly ahead of broader IMFL growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Magic Moments vodka delivered a landmark performance in Q1 FY27 with 3.25 million cases at a 43 percent year-on-year growth rate.
demand_outlook.quote: The brand delivered a landmark performance during the quarter with 3.25 million cases at a growth rate of 43% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Flavored vodka accounts for 75 percent of the company's vodka volumes, up from 65 percent last year.
demand_outlook.quote: Flavored vodka today accounts for 75% of our volumes, up from 65% last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian spirits sales volume in CY2025 is estimated at 416 million cases, marking an increase of 3.9% over CY2024.
demand_outlook.quote: o Spirits sales in India is estimated to be at 416 million cases in CY2025, representing an increase of 3.9% over CY2024

demand_outlook.claim: During the CY2025-30 period, IMFL sales volume is expected to grow at a CAGR of 3.5% and sales value at 6.8%.
demand_outlook.quote: o During CY2025-30 period, IMFL sales volume is expected to grow at a CAGR of 3.5% and sales value at 6.8%

demand_outlook.claim: White spirits, Vodka and Gin, remain the fastest growing category in volume and value terms.
demand_outlook.quote: o White spirits, Vodka and Gin, remain the fastest growing category in volume and value terms

capex_expansion.claim: Annual maintenance capex is projected to be in the range of Rs. 150 crores to Rs. 170 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So as of now, our maintenance capex would be in the range of Rs. 150 crores to Rs. 170 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross margin expanded by 440 basis points year-on-year to 48.0 percent in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin during the quarter was 48.0%, representing a 440 bps expansion Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that higher levels of stock were built up to mitigate the impact of increasing grain prices to a large extent.
margins_costs.quote: To mitigate the impact of increasing grain prices to a large extent, we had built up higher level of stocks which has supported us through Q2 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to maintain A&SP spend around 6 percent to 8 percent of IMFL revenues.
margins_costs.quote: On a quarterly basis, the amount may vary but we expect to maintain A&SP spend around 6% to 8% of our IMFL revenues to be able to drive the sales momentum.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q1 FY27 was 49.1 percent, representing a 610 basis point expansion year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On profitability front, gross margin during the quarter was 49.1%, representing 610 basis point expansion on year-on-year basis and 110 basis point expansion on quarter-on-quarter basis.

margins_costs.claim: Volatility in packing material prices resulted in approximately Rs. 30 crores of financial impact during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: This is despite the recent volatility in the packing material prices, which resulted in approximately Rs. 30 crores of financial impact.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 reached its highest-ever level at 20.7 percent.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 20.7%, expanding by 536 basis points year-on-year to its highest-ever level.

margins_costs.claim: Non-IMFL business margin is around 11 to 11.5 percent.
margins_costs.quote: Non-IMFL business margin is around 11 to 11.5% and the IMFL margin is 23% plus.

orders_capacity.claim: Radico Khaitan reported its highest ever quarterly volume of 10 million cases in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: During Q1 FY27, we reported highest ever quarterly volume of 10 million cases, revenue of Rs. 1,684 crores and EBITDA of Rs. 348 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Total ENA requirement is between 28 crores and 30 crores liters, while captive production capacity stands at 33 crores liters.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our total requirement is in the range of around 28 crores to 30 crores liters between our IMFL and non-IMFL both put together, and for Rampur plant, Sitapur plant and our joint venture, we make 33 crores liters.

capital_allocation.claim: Term loans reduced by Rs 75.7 Crore since March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Including Term Loans of ` 54.3 Cr (reduction in TL of ` 75.7 Cr since March 31, 2026)

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt was reduced by Rs. 138 crores since March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Further strengthening our financial position, we have reduced our net debt by Rs. 138 crores since March 2026, supported by a healthy profitability and robust cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to become net debt free by Q2 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet remains strong and we are on track to become net debt free by Q2 FY27.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global environment has turned increasingly volatile with heightened uncertainty around input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global environment has turned increasingly volatile, with heightened uncertainty around input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a dynamic global environment marked by geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a dynamic global environment, marked by geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain challenges, we expanded our operating margins through a richer product mix, disciplined cost management and continued operational excellence.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to be net debt free during H2 FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Net Debt free during H2 FY2027

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach 100 travel retail outlets in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: Building on around 70 travel retail outlets currently, we are steadily progressing towards our target of 100 in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to maintain A&SP spend around 6 percent to 8 percent of IMFL revenues.
management_commitments.quote: On a quarterly basis, the amount may vary but we expect to maintain A&SP spend around 6% to 8% of our IMFL revenues to be able to drive the sales momentum.

management_commitments.claim: Management upgraded Prestige & Above volume growth guidance to 30 percent and reiterated EBITDA margin guidance of around 20 percent for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We upgrade our Prestige & Above volume growth guidance to 30% and reiterate EBITDA margin guidance of around 20% for FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to achieve 25% growth in the sales value of its luxury portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: And we gave a guidance of 25% increase in the sales value of our luxury portfolio. And I think we are on target to achieve the 25% growth in our luxury portfolio.

management_commitments.claim: The company is on track to become net debt free by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our balance sheet remains strong and we are on track to become net debt free by Q2 FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
